posts.cooked:
Had an odd bug happen, was wondering if anyone else had it happen to them.

In a match in the Temple of Zhu Long, Argent Adept ended up with a Shinobi Assassin on top of his deck. I played an Instrumental Conjuration to search the deck for an instrument, at which point the deck should have shuffled. However, it did not.

Odd thing was, the next turn I played another Instrumental Conjuration, and this time the deck did shuffle. It was odd, and I can't think of any reason why the deck shouldn't have shuffled the first time.

Anyone else run into this?

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Shuffles will always shuffle the same way if done at the same time.  Rewinding resets the RNG seed to ensure the same shuffle comes out.  That way, you can't cheat by repeatably rewinding until you get a good shuffle.

Now, if you were taking out a different instrument each time, that would cause different shuffles.  If it was the same one, you will always get the same shuffle, though.
